summary: Nginx is running on all four nodes and serves HTTP 200 at / on TCP port 6700.
actions_performed: Installed Nginx on AlmaLinux node1/node2 and Alpine node3/node4.
Enabled Nginx at boot and started it on every node.
Allowed TCP 6700 through SELinux and firewalld on the AlmaLinux hosts.
Verified each service directly through its managed-node IP.

evidence.summary: Confirmed node1/node2 run AlmaLinux 9.6 and node3/node4 run Alpine Linux 3.23.

evidence.requirement: node1 serves / over HTTP on TCP 6700
evidence.summary: Nginx was active and enabled, listening on 0.0.0.0:6700, and returned HTTP/1.1 200 OK through 10.100.41.10:6700/.

evidence.requirement: node2 serves / over HTTP on TCP 6700
evidence.summary: Nginx was active and enabled, listening on 0.0.0.0:6700, and returned HTTP/1.1 200 OK through 10.100.41.11:6700/.

evidence.requirement: node3 serves / over HTTP on TCP 6700
evidence.summary: Nginx was started and registered in the default OpenRC runlevel, listening on 0.0.0.0:6700, and returned HTTP/1.1 200 OK through 10.100.41.12:6700/.

evidence.requirement: node4 serves / over HTTP on TCP 6700
evidence.summary: Nginx was started and registered in the default OpenRC runlevel, listening on 0.0.0.0:6700, and returned HTTP/1.1 200 OK through 10.100.41.13:6700/.
TCP 6700 is labeled http_port_t under enforcing SELinux and allowed in both runtime and permanent firewalld configuration on node1/node2.
